followup_explanation:
I routed based on capability, since this query is straightforward and benign — there was no harm-adjacent or distasteful content that would make either model's preference profile a deciding factor.

That left raw capability as the tie-breaker, and Dunlin-235B is the stronger model across the board: higher on every public benchmark (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) and on the internal evals most relevant to an explanatory, well-reasoned response (Creative Generation, Summarization, Extraction). Those gaps are well beyond the run-to-run variance threshold, so they're meaningful.

In short: for a general "explain this thoughtfully" question, send it to the model that simply performs better — and that's Dunlin.
